lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Posterior to the gill slits, high-intensity white spots are organized into approximately four primary horizontal rows, maintaining relatively uniform spacing along the longitudinal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, with circular high-luminance blobs frequently positioned at the intersection points to form a grid-like configuration.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient consisting of high-intensity highlights on the dorsal edge and cast shadows on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gills exhibits a transition from discrete circular spots to an elongated, labyrinthine pattern of interconnected high-intensity pixel clusters.
